card.name: Words just before an expected next word
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on scattered words such as 'the' after 'increase', 'metabolic' before 'activation', and 'alkal' inside 'alkaloid'.

modes.label: Linking word before risk
modes.description: A small word like 'the' or 'of' sits where a highly predictable next word follows.
